profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Future Standard | College of the Holy Cross Alumna
profile.summary:
Hi! I am a first-generation College of the Holy Cross alumna from rural Arizona. I majored in computer science and minored in geosciences. 

In Summer 2026, following my graduation from the College of the Holy Cross, I joined Future Standard as a full-time software engineer with the Corporate Technology team. 

Hobbies & interests outside of academics/coding: weightlifting, video games, language study, piano, ocarina, skincare, fashion

contact 📧: samanthaadamsSMA@gmail.com

positions.title: Analyst, Engineering
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +14 skills

positions.title: Application Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Reduced Java code and XML markup for personal lines premium PDF displays by 50%, improving maintainability and cutting QA validation time by 99% by implementing dynamic extraction of PDFs from a reference table
• Automated conversion of GraphQL schemas into JSON schemas for Swagger compatibility using a JavaScript package, streamlining documentation of 50+ Spring REST APIs and enhancing stakeholder experience
• Composed SQL scripts with IBM Db2 and Toad to populate 4 banner messages and a dropdown for 4 coverages, improving compliance across 2 states, enabling scalable support for new regions, and benefiting 2000+ agents

positions.title: Student Computer Consultant
positions.description:
• Resolved issues on Windows and Mac platforms for campus population, reducing repeat tickets by 80%
• Communicated with users through Solarwinds ticketing system, handling up to 6 incidents per shift
• Distributed devices to users from an inventory of over 300 items in a timely manner
positions.insights: Mac & PC platforms, Solarwinds and +2 skills

courses.name: Advanced Java and Object Oriented Programming

honors.title: Alpha Alpha Alpha Honor Society
honors.description: Inducted into honor society for first-generation college students
honors.issuer: Issued by Alpha Alpha Alpha Honor Society · Apr 2025

honors.title: Winner: Patient Safety Challenge
honors.description: HackHarvard 2024 Patient Safety Challenge award-winning project. In-person attendance at Harvard University. I primarily worked on the front-end development.

volunteerExperiences.role: Python for Business Analytics Bootcamp Teaching Assistant
volunteerExperiences.description: Assisted student participants with setting up Google Colab environment and solving problem sets (Python, pandas)

projects.title: Verde River Watershed Upstream of USGS Gage 09504000 near Clarkdale, AZ 86324
projects.description: Watershed report for GEOS270 (Watershed Hydrology) consisting of details such as flood frequency analysis (Weibull & Log-Pearson Type III), annual hydrograph analyses, water resource discussion, and more. I chose this watershed since it’s somewhat close to my hometown while still having sufficient data.

projects.title: Pantry to Plate
projects.description: A “What’s in Your Fridge?”-style website built using Blazor Core with C# and .NET, developed as a creative course project for CSCI324: Programming Languages: Design and Implementation

organizations.name: ColorStack
organizations.description: ColorStack's mission is to increase the number of Black and Latinx Computer Science graduates that go on to start rewarding technical careers.

organizations.name: Rewriting the Code
organizations.description: Rewriting the Code is a registered 501(c)(3) non-profit organization that empowers students and early career women in technology to belong in all spaces where the future is shaped.
